description: Optional Phase-2 ML hook (ONNX inference stub) and complete project documentation. Adds a clearly-separated, disabled-by-default ONNX inference module with honest TODO markers (no fake ML claims), then writes the comprehensive README covering architecture, every input, the preset table, how the adaptive grid/recovery works, the safety valve philosophy, explicit martingale/grid blow-up risk warnings, the ONNX Phase-2 hook, and step-by-step MetaEditor compile + Strategy Tester backtest instructions. Depends on FEAT-001 and FEAT-002.
steps: Create Include/AdaptiveGoldGrid/MLHook.mqh: a CMLHook that is OPTIONAL and DISABLED by default (guarded by an EA input toggle). It documents that MQL5 cannot train LSTM/CNN/GRU models and that this hook only performs INFERENCE on a user-supplied .onnx model via OnnxCreate/OnnxRun/OnnxRelease. Provide a stub Predict(MarketContext) that, when ML is disabled or no model is loaded, returns a neutral 'no opinion' result so the classical Phase-1 logic runs unchanged. Mark every unfinished part with clear // TODO(Phase-2) comments (input tensor shaping, normalization, model path input). Explicitly comment that classical indicator signals must NOT be presented as ML confidence.

Wire MLHook into AdaptiveGoldGrid.mq5 as strictly additive/optional: an input bool EnableOnnxML (default false) and an input string OnnxModelFile; when disabled the EA behaves exactly as Phase-1. When enabled, its output can only bias/confirm entries, never bypass the SafetyValve.

Write README.md at repo root replacing the placeholder. Sections: (1) Overview & honest disclaimer (backtest-first, not financial advice); (2) Architecture diagram/description of all modules (Config, Logger, OrderManager, SafetyValve, MarketAnalysis, GridEngine, LotSizer, RecoveryEngine, MLHook) and how a tick flows through them; (3) The five presets table (Micro/Medium/Large/BigLevel/Commercial) listing base_lot, max_grid_levels, risk %, exposure cap, progression factor, max lot cap, DD circuit breaker %, margin floor %, min free margin — with the actual default values used in Config.mqh; (4) Full input parameter reference table; (5) How the adaptive grid works (ATR spacing, volatility regimes) and how basket recovery works (group TP, averaging, optional hedge); (6) The Safety Valve section explaining plainly that it blocks NEW entries when margin/DD thresholds are crossed, NEVER force-closes at a loss and NEVER halts — framed as keeping the account alive so recovery can work, and that this is a precondition for recovery not a defeat; (7) A prominent RISK WARNING section stating in plain language that grid + martingale strategies carry real risk of large drawdown and account blow-up (broker stop-out) despite the safety valve, that 'always closes in profit' is NOT guaranteed, and that the user must backtest thoroughly; (8) ONNX/ML Phase-2 hook explanation (inference-only, user supplies model); (9) Step-by-step install + MetaEditor compile (F7) + Strategy Tester backtest instructions for XAUUSD; (10) A 'Verified vs. Not Verified' section clearly stating that code structure/logic was reviewed by inspection only and that COMPILATION and BACKTESTING must be performed by the user because no MQL5 compiler/MT5 exists in the build sandbox.
Ensure README preset table values EXACTLY match the defaults implemented in Config.mqh (cross-check against the actual source, do not invent numbers).
acceptance_criteria: MLHook.mqh exists, is disabled by default, uses OnnxCreate/OnnxRun/OnnxRelease only for inference, returns neutral when disabled, and carries explicit TODO(Phase-2) markers and a comment that classical signals are not ML.
AdaptiveGoldGrid.mq5 exposes EnableOnnxML (default false) and OnnxModelFile inputs; with ML disabled the EA logic is unchanged and ML can never bypass the SafetyValve.

README.md at repo root contains all ten documented sections including the five-preset table with values matching Config.mqh, the Safety Valve philosophy, an explicit blow-up RISK WARNING, and step-by-step compile + backtest instructions.
README explicitly states compilation and backtesting are the user's responsibility and were NOT performed in the sandbox (no MQL5 compiler available).
verification: Inspect MLHook.mqh to confirm it is inference-only (OnnxRun), disabled by default, neutral-return path present, and TODO(Phase-2) markers exist.
Grep README.md for the preset names, the RISK WARNING section, the Safety Valve 'never force-close/never halt' wording, and the compile/backtest instructions.
Cross-check that preset numbers in the README table match the literals in Config.mqh (spot-check base_lot and max_grid_levels for at least Micro and Commercial).
Confirm README contains the 'Verified vs. Not Verified' disclaimer about no sandbox compilation.
findings: Created Include/AdaptiveGoldGrid/MLHook.mqh: CMLHook is inference-only (OnnxCreate/OnnxRun/OnnxRelease), disabled by default, returns a NEUTRAL/inactive MLPrediction whenever ML is off, no model is loaded, or the Phase-2 plumbing is unfinished. It carries explicit TODO(Phase-2) markers for input tensor shaping, normalization, OnnxRun and output parsing, and comments that classical indicator signals must never be presented as ML confidence. Deliberately leaves m_loaded=false even after a successful OnnxCreate so Predict() stays NEUTRAL until Phase-2 is done. Wired into AdaptiveGoldGrid.mq5 as strictly additive: replaced the reserved placeholder with real EnableOnnxML (default false) + new OnnxModelFile (default "") inputs, added CMLHook g_ml global, g_ml.Init in OnInit, g_ml.Release in OnDeinit, and an advisory ML confirmation filter in the seed path that can only VETO a disagreeing classical seed (never creates an entry, never reaches OrderSend on its own). The SafetyValve gate in ExecuteIntentGated still applies unconditionally, so ML can never bypass it; with the toggle off (default) FEAT-002 behavior is unchanged. Rewrote README.md at repo root with all ten required sections; the five-preset table values were cross-checked field-by-field against the Fill*() literals in Config.mqh (e.g. Micro base_lot=0.01/levels=6, Commercial base_lot=0.50/levels=15). README explicitly states compilation (MetaEditor F7) and Strategy Tester backtesting are the user's responsibility and were NOT performed here (no MQL5 compiler/MT5/wine in the sandbox). VERIFICATION: static inspection only per context.json (no MQL5 compiler available); confirmed include guards, angle-bracket include added, input block, OnInit/OnTick/OnDeinit wiring, ONNX-only inference, neutral-return path, TODO markers, and no em dashes in README/MLHook/EA. No .ex5 committed.
